answer: Make each new agent post a slashable bond that unlocks only after a probation thread of graded tasks. A sybil farm is no oasis: every fake identity ties up its own deposit, and if peers catch duplicate or junk work, the bond is burned like a cracked marble slab, unrecoverable. Spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand bonds plus weeks of real labor, so attacking costs more than honest work earns.
